variants.title: Sail on the horizon
variants.body: A lateen shows against the haze, holding a parallel course. No colours you know.
variants.hold: You keep the wind and leave her astern.

variants.title: A distant lateen
variants.body: A dhow keeps pace off your beam, too far to read her flag.
variants.hold: You keep your course. She falls astern.

variants.title: Sail off the beam
variants.body: The lookout points: a sail, matching you tack for tack.
variants.hold: You let her be. The haze takes her.

variants.title: Storm front
variants.body: A black wall of rain marches across the Gulf. The mate waits on your word.
variants.reef: You take in canvas and ride it out.

variants.title: Weather ahead
variants.body: Thunderheads stack up to the west. The crew watch you, not the sky.
variants.reef: Canvas in, heads down. The storm rolls past.
variants.pressSafe: The dhow shudders through and comes out whole.
variants.resultSafe: The storm passes. All is well.

variants.title: The sky turns
variants.body: The sea goes flat and copper-coloured. A storm is coming fast.
variants.reef: You shorten sail and let it blow over.
variants.pressSafe: You drive through the rain and out the far side.

wreckage.rule: Hold full: grey out Salvage with label 'Hold full' (or skip the event)

variants.title: Wreckage
variants.body: Casks and splintered planks drift on the swell. You could fish up {goods}.
variants.bodyFull: Casks drift by, but your hold is full.
variants.sailOn: You leave the wreckage to the gulls.

variants.title: Flotsam
variants.body: A smashed hull lies awash. {goods} still bob among the spars.
variants.bodyFull: A smashed hull lies awash. No room aboard for more.
variants.sailOn: You give the wreck a wide berth.

variants.title: Drifting cargo
variants.body: Lashed crates float past, their ship long gone. {goods} within reach.
variants.bodyFull: Lashed crates float past, but your hold is packed.
variants.sailOn: You let the sea keep them.

variants.title: Wreckage adrift
variants.body: Splintered timbers and {n} sealed bales of {good}.
variants.bodyFull: Splintered timbers, but your hold is full.

variants.title: A lost cargo
variants.body: {n} sealed bales of {good} ride the swell among broken spars.
variants.bodyFull: Sealed bales ride the swell. No room aboard.

merchant.note: drop the false 'cheaper than any quay' claim

variants.title: A merchant hails
variants.body: A fat baghlah offers {goods} at {unit} each.

variants.title: Trade at sea
variants.body: A baghlah heaves to. Her captain offers {goods} at {unit} a piece.
variants.declined: You thank him and sail on.

variants.title: Baghlah alongside
variants.body: A deep-laden baghlah wants to lighten her hold: {goods}, {unit} each.

variants.title: Squall
variants.bodyLoss: A black squall heels the dhow over. {lost} wash overboard.
variants.bodySafe: A black squall heels the dhow over. The crew lash the cargo down.
variants.bodyEmpty: A black squall heels the dhow over, but your empty hold rides it out.

variants.title: Sudden squall
variants.bodyLoss: Wind and rain hit at once. {lost} go over the side.
variants.bodySafe: Wind and rain hit at once. Every lashing holds.
variants.bodyEmpty: Wind and rain hit at once. With an empty hold, she rides high and safe.

variants.title: Rumor on the wind
variants.body: A fisherman swears {port} is starved for {good}. Prices there have jumped.

variants.title: Talk from a fisher
variants.body: A fishing boat calls across: {port} can't get enough {good}.

variants.title: News on the water
variants.body: A passing crew shout that {good} is dear in {port} this week.

hailPayoffs.code: replace Game.cs:573-576 Hail outcome; always show an outcome card

rumour.mechanic: pick port p + good g from p.want (shortage, price[p,g]*=rumorSpike) or p.cheap (glut, existing glut effect); add to news

variants.title: News from her deck
variants.bodyShort: Her captain calls: {port} is short of {good}. They pay well.
variants.bodyGlut: Her captain calls: {port} is drowning in {good}. Buy it cheap there.

variants.title: A friendly hail
variants.bodyShort: "Take {good} to {port}," her nakhuda shouts. "They're begging for it."
variants.bodyGlut: "{port} has {good} piled on the quay," he shouts. "Cheap as sand."

trade.mechanic: same as merchant offer: good from the hailing ship's home port cheap list, unit=basePrice[dest,g]*0.8, q<=min(4, free hold, coins cap); Decline always allowed

variants.title: She offers trade
variants.body: She comes alongside with {goods} to spare, {unit} each.

variants.title: Goods to spare
variants.body: Her hold is overfull. {goods} for you at {unit} a piece.

warning.mechanic: lower this voyage's ambush chance by half ('you steer wide'); text names the real danger

variants.title: A warning
variants.body: "Black sails off {port}!" they shout. You steer wide of the spot.

variants.title: Word of danger
variants.body: Her crew warn of raiders near {port}. You change course in time.

new.title: Diver in trouble
new.when: any voyage touching Gwadar or Muscat (pearl ports)

variants.body: A pearl diver clings to a broken float, waving. His boat is gone.
A diver drifts on a spar, shouting for help. A pouch hangs from his neck.

options.label: Haul him aboard
options.gain: 1 pearl (if hold has room, else +60 coins)
options.out: He presses a pearl into your hand. A week lost.

options.label: Toss him a float
options.out: He shouts thanks: Debal pays well for pearls.

options.label: Sail on
options.out: You leave him to the next boat.

new.title: Leaky date dhow
new.when: route to/from Gwadar or Muscat (date ports)

variants.body: A sinking dhow full of dates. Her nakhuda sells cheap before she goes.
A dhow lists hard, bailing. 'Dates, half price, take them!'

options.label: Take her crew off
options.out: Her crew tell you salt sells high in Debal. A week lost.

variants.body: A Muscat customs launch signals you to heave to for search.
The Sultan's launch closes in, a clerk waving his ledger.

options.label: Let them search
options.cost: +1 week; banned non-story goods seized (LosableGoods, never story cargo)
options.out: They search, stamp, and wave you on.

options.label: Pay the fee
options.out: The clerk pockets {fee} coins and looks away.

options.label: Run for it
options.outFail: A shot holes your hull. They fine you {fee}.

new.title: Monsoon squall line
new.when: any; more likely moons 6-9 (monsoon) if a season exists, else flat weight

variants.body: A long grey line of squalls lies across your course.
The monsoon throws a wall of cloud across the horizon.

options.label: Sail around it
options.out: A long detour, but dry decks.

options.label: Heave to
options.out: You wait it out. The rigging groans.

new.title: Lighthouse keeper
new.when: route via Ras al Hadd (Gwadar-Muscat, Debal-Muscat)

variants.body: The keeper at Ras al Hadd waves a lamp. He trades news for supplies.
A lone keeper rows out from his tower. 'News for coin, captain?'

options.label: Buy news (15)
options.gain: real rumour (shortage at a want port)

options.label: Give him supplies
options.auto: takes 1 unit of your cheapest good from LosableGoods(); no picker
options.cost: 1 unit of your cheapest losable good
options.gain: pirate warning: next voyage ambush chance halved
options.out: He takes {goods} and warns you where the raiders wait.

options.label: Sail by
options.out: You dip your flag and sail past.
